title: Tech Lead Analyst, Software Engineering and Data Science (Open to Internal and External applicants)
description:
Overview

Tiered Approach In Line With The Commitment To Safeguard Capacity And Support Personnel Already In The Organization, a Majority Of UNDP UNCDF/UNV Vacancies Are Advertised Using a Tiered Application Process Whereby

  • Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.
  • Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments
  • Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
  • Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Job Description

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

UNDP provides integrated programmatic, policy and financing solutions to realize the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). In this context, UNDP has created a Global Policy Network (GPN), a network of field-based and global technical expertise across a wide range of knowledge domains and in support of the signature solutions and organizational capabilities envisioned in the Strategic Plan. The Bureau for Policy and Programme Support (BPPS) and the Crisis Bureau (CB) are the two anchor Bureaux of the GPN.

In this context, the newly established Governance, Rule of Law, and Peacebuilding (GRP) Hub, a joint endeavor with the Bureau for Policy and Programme Support (BPPS), provides leadership and advisory services to enhance UNDP’s impact on governance and peacebuilding, ensuring the integration of democratic governance and human rights into crisis response and recovery.

Through Local Action, the GRP Hub seeks to contribute to peace and development, achieving a visible impact on communities and improving lives by delivering integrated solutions that harness global expertise and partnerships. The Local Action Unit works closely with local and regional governments as key development players, highlighting their role as public service implementers, as drivers of innovation and the closest institution to people.

Local and regional governments are already responsible for over 65% of the SDG targets, most of them linked to basic service provision from water, sanitation, mobility, climate action, health or education. Cities and territories are playing a big part in the implementation of SDGs, becoming a tool for strategic planning and budgeting in the mid to long term. Since 2015, local governments and their associations have been active in promoting the SDGs through advocacy, working with their local population and partners in transposing the spirit of Agenda 2030 in cities and territories. Local Governments have also started to use SDGs as a framework to deliver better public services linked to SDG targets and indicators. As part of the SDG Local Action project, UNDP is one of the implementing partners of the Mayors Challenge, a global initiative to reimagine essential services that cities deliver to residents.

Duties And Responsibilities

Under the overall supervision of the Project Manager and in close coordination with IplanRio, relevant municipal technical teams, and UNDP, the Tech Lead Analyst, Software Engineering and Data Science will perform the following functions:

  • Lead data engineering and integration
  • Lead the modeling, integration, and transformation of data from multiple municipal secretariats into the Integrated Municipal Registry (RMI)
  • Oversee the development and maintenance of reproducible, scalable, and well-documented data pipelines
  • Ensure data quality, consistency, traceability, and governance across project data assets
  • Guide technical decisions related to data architecture and interoperability
  • Lead analytical and machine learning development
  • Lead the development of analytical and machine learning models to identify patterns, risks, and opportunities relevant to public service delivery
  • Oversee exploratory data analysis and validation processes to generate actionable insights
  • Ensure appropriate model testing, monitoring, and refinement over time
  • Apply and promote the use of model interpretability techniques, where relevant
  • Support product development and decision-making
  • Translate analytical results into practical recommendations and data products for public policy use
  • Work closely with technical teams and sectoral teams to align solutions with operational and policy needs
  • Contribute to the design of proactive communication and service delivery mechanisms informed by data
  • Ensure technical standards, sustainability and knowledge management
  • Establish and promote best practices for versioning, documentation, reproducibility, and code quality
  • Contribute to the definition of technical standards, architecture, and implementation approaches for the project
  • Support the long-term sustainability, maintainability, and scalability of the solution
  • Provide technical guidance to other team members and facilitate collaboration across disciplines

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the project.

Institutional Arrangements

The Tech Lead Analyst will act in close coordination with the Project manager, allocated at IplanRio, municipal technical teams from the City Hall, including the relevant teams from Health, Education, and Social Assistance, and UNDP, contributing to the technical implementation of the project.

The Analyst will report to the Advisor, cities and local governments based in UNDP HQ in New York, USA.

Competencies

Core Competencies

  • Achieve Results: LEVEL 2: Scale up solutions and simplifies processes, balances speed and accuracy in doing work.
  • Think Innovatively: LEVEL 2: Offer new ideas/open to new approaches, demonstrate systemic/integrated thinking.
  • Learn Continuously: LEVEL 2: Go outside comfort zone, learn from others and support their learning.
  • Adapt with Agility: LEVEL 2: Adapt processes/approaches to new situations, involve others in change process.
  • Act with Determination: LEVEL 2: Able to persevere and deal with multiple sources of pressure simultaneously.
  • Engage and Partner: LEVEL 2: Is facilitator/integrator, bring people together, build and/or/maintain coalitions/partnership.
  • Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 2: Facilitate conversations to bridge differences, considers in decision making.

Functional/Technical competencies

  • Business Management: Communication – Ability to communicate in a clear, concise and unambiguous manner both through written and verbal communication; to tailor messages and choose communication methods depending on the audience.
  • Business Management: Working with Evidence and Data – Ability to inspect, cleanse, transform and model data with the goal of discovering useful information, informing conclusions and supporting decision-making.
  • Business Direction & Strategy: System Thinking – Ability to use objective problem analysis and judgement to understand how interrelated elements coexist within an overall process or system, and to consider how altering one element can impact on other parts of the system.
  • Digital: Data engineering – Ability in programming languages such as SQL, Python, and R, be adept at finding warehousing solutions, and using ETL tools, and understanding basic machine learning and algorithms.
  • Digital: Data governance – Knowledge of data science, skills to develop data management tools, organize and maintain databases and operate data visualization technologies.
  • Information Management & Technology: Data Management & Analytics – Knowledge in data management, data sciences, ability to structure data, develop dashboard and visualization. Design data warehouses, data lakes or data platforms concepts. Familiarity with Machine learning, natural language processing or generation and the use of artificial intelligence to support predictive analytics. CDMP or TOGAF9 or equivalent certification desirable.

Education

Required Skills and Experience

  • Advanced university degree (master’s degree or equivalent) in Data Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Information Systems, or a related field is required.
  • A first-level university degree (bachelor’s degree) in the above-mentioned fields, in combination with an additional two (2) years of qualifying experience, will be given due consideration in lieu of the advanced university degree.

Experience

  • Minimum two (2) years (with a master’s degree) or four (4) years of (with a Bachelor’s degree) of qualifying experience includes in data modeling and machine learning, complex data and integration of multiple sources, developing analytical pipelines, software development.

Required Skills

  • Proficiency in Python (including pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels)
  • Proficiency in SQL
  • Experience with versioning and reproducibility practices, including Git
  • Experience with DBT and BigQuery

Desired Additional Skills

  • Experience with governmental data or public policies
  • Experience with interpretability techniques such as SHAP or LIME
  • Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow or Prefect
  • Experience with dashboards and data visualization; experience with Google Cloud Platform
  • Experience leading or coordinating technical teams

Language Requirements

  • Fluency in Portuguese and English is required.

Professional Certificates

  • Technical certifications in cloud platforms, data engineering, machine learning, or software development are an asset.

Equal Opportunity

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity and encourages qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination. UNDP is also committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission.

Safety and Compliance

UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination or abuse of authority. All selected candidates undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.

Right to Select Multiple Candidates

UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.

Use of AI by Candidates

Applicants are invited to read UNDP’s guidance for candidates on using AI responsibly in UNDP recruitment and selection.

Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM se consolidou como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução, atuando em diferentes frentes e adaptando-se continuamente às transformações do mercado.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a Ekotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Somos um Grupo formado por marcas que possuem mais de 45 anos de experiência na área da saúde, e estamos presentes nos estados do Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo realizando mais de 456 mil consultas anuais e cuidando da vida de mais de 100 mil pacientes. Simplificamos para fazer bem feito: Antecipamos os problemas e buscamos realizar as atividades da forma mais eficiente, agindo de imediato e de forma coordenada com foco na solução.

Queremos mais: Buscamos incansavelmente a evolução, valorizando feedbacks e nos preocupando em sempre entregar a melhor experiência.

Empoderamos as pessoas: Somos proativos para solucionar problemas e buscar oportunidades, assumimos responsabilidade pelas atividades exercidas, sem transferi-la para outros.

Se você quer fazer a diferença, achou o lugar certo!

Venha fazer história com a gente!

description:
Descrição da vaga

A área de engenharia de dados é responsável por garantir que a organização tenha acesso a dados confiáveis e organizados, possibilitando a criação de insights e a tomada de decisões estratégicas e operacionais. Ser um agente de transformação, construindo uma plataforma escalável e resiliente, democratizar o acesso aos dados e impulsionar uma cultura orientada por dados. Missão da vaga: Projetar, construir e manter pipelines robustos de dados, garantindo que as informações fluam de maneira eficiente e segura. Garantir a disponibilidade, qualidade e governança dos dados. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders e a equipe visando promover melhores práticas na manipulação, análise de grandes volumes de dados e otimização de processos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Projetar, construir e manter pipelines de dados robustos e escaláveis para ingestão, processamento e transformação de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Desenvolver e otimizar modelos de dados para sistemas analíticos;
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de armazenamento, incluindo data lakes e data warehouses, em ambientes em nuvem;
  • Garantir a integridade, qualidade e governança dos dados, aplicando boas práticas de gerenciamento e segurança e FINOPS;
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos de negócio e oferecer soluções orientadas por dados;
  • Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho de pipelines, bases de dados e soluções de integração;
  • Liderar iniciativas de modernização de arquitetura de dados, utilizando tecnologias e frameworks modernos;
  • Atuar como referência técnica e mentorar engenheiros de dados juniores e plenos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência comprovada com plataformas de data visualização (tableau, power bi e/ou looker);
  • Histórico de liderança ou participação ativa em projetos complexos de integração e migração para nuvem;

Conhecimentos Técnicos

  • Cloud Computing;
  • Experiência em GCP e seus serviços, BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Apache Airflow, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud Function, KMS, Secret Manager;
  • DataStream, Vertex AI e GitHub;
  • Experiência em Azure e seus serviços, como Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics e Azure Data Lake Storage;
  • Banco de Dados: Conhecimento em modelagem de dados, bancos de dados relacionais (ex.: Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) e não relacionais (ex.: MongoDB, Cassandra);
  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em Python e PySpark (usado para scripts e automação) e SQL (para manipulação e consulta de dados);
  • ETL/ELT: Experiência na construção de pipelines de ETL/ELT para ingestão e transformação de dados;
  • Data Lakes: Conhecimento de arquiteturas de Data Lake, armazenamento e otimização de dados (ex.: Delta Lake);
  • DevOps: Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD e práticas de DataOps para automação de deploys e monitoramento de fluxos de dados;
  • Segurança e Governança: Entendimento de práticas de segurança em nuvem, criptografia de dados e implementação de políticas de governança;
  • Orquestração de Dados: Uso de ferramentas como Azure Data Factory e/ou Synapse e/ou Airflow/composer para integração e movimentação de dados;
  • Desempenho e Otimização: Experiência em técnicas para melhorar a performance de pipelines de dados e consultas em ambientes distribuídos e não distribuídos;
  • APIs: Conhecimento em extração de dados via APIs RESTful.

Sobre a Eneva

A Eneva é a maior operadora privada de gás natural do Brasil, atuando de forma integrada da produção à geração de energia e avançando de maneira consistente na comercialização de gás natural. Em 2026, a companhia atravessa um ciclo de crescimento impulsionado por novos projetos estruturantes, operações de O&M e iniciativas de expansão (CAPEX), o que exige excelência em logística, comércio exterior, compliance regulatório e eficiência operacional em operações de alta complexidade.

A posição terá forte atuação em projetos de grande porte, operações O&M e cargas especiais, assegurando integração com áreas internas e parceiros estratégicos.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Atuar como referência técnica em comércio exterior e logística nacional, assegurando a conformidade das operações de importação, exportação e transporte doméstico com a legislação aduaneira, tributária, regulatória e normas aplicáveis;
  • Liderar tecnicamente a gestão end-to-end de operações de importação, exportação e logística nacional em projetos estratégicos e de grande porte, desde o planejamento até a entrega final;
  • Avaliar, interpretar e aplicar legislações aduaneiras brasileiras, tratados internacionais e normas de órgãos anuentes (Receita Federal, Anvisa, MAPA, Ibama, entre outros), orientando áreas internas quanto a riscos, oportunidades fiscais e compliance;
  • Desenvolver e conduzir estratégias logísticas e aduaneiras para projetos de engenharia, expansão, CAPEX e O&M, incluindo cargas especiais, superdimensionadas e sensíveis;
  • Analisar e validar classificações fiscais (NCM), descrições técnicas, valores aduaneiros e enquadramentos tributários, propondo melhorias para mitigação de riscos fiscais;
  • Planejar, estruturar e acompanhar a aplicação de regimes aduaneiros especiais (Ex-tarifário, Admissão Temporária, Entreposto Aduaneiro, Repetro e similares);
  • Atuar estrategicamente na gestão de contratos logísticos e aduaneiros, contribuindo para definição de escopos, SLAs, KPIs e estratégias de sourcing;
  • Conduzir análises avançadas de custos logísticos e de importação, elaborando estudos de viabilidade econômica e cenários comparativos;
  • Gerenciar indicadores estratégicos de performance logística e aduaneira, liderando planos de ação e iniciativas de melhoria contínua;
  • Atuar como interface técnica com despachantes aduaneiros, autoridades, operadores logísticos e fornecedores estratégicos;
  • Antecipar riscos operacionais, financeiros e regulatórios, propondo soluções preventivas relacionadas a prazos, demurrage, armazenagem e licenças;

title: Offshore Logistics Coordinator
description:
Overview

Airswift is looking for an Offshore Logistics Coordinator (12 months) to work in a contractor position in Rio de Janeiro for an oil and gas company.

Responsibilities

  • Maintains daily contact with the Well Site Leader (WSL) to define personnel and equipment schedules for time planning.
  • Updates the equivalent logistics system with information on the movement of personnel, equipment, solid bulk, and fluids.
  • Updates the operational status of the logistics system with information on vessel movement, obtains approval from the WSL, and sends it to the daily distribution list.
  • Updates the logistics system with information on vessel operations during the night, using feedback from the night shift deck crew.
  • Updates unloading and return documentation and distributes it to the day shift deck crew.
  • Sends a daily plan to the vessel for both shifts. If there is a need to transport Dangerous Goods (DG) on the vessel's return, prepares the DG documentation and transfers it to the vessel.
  • Completes the daily cost spreadsheet and sends it to the Drilling Engineer.
  • Completes all documentation prior to the completion of vessel operations (Safety Data Sheet, return manifest, and waste transfer notes).
  • Obtains the mud analysis from the Mud Engineer and sends it, along with the documentation, to the vessel.
  • Monitors weather conditions for the vessel's next departure to verify that there are suitable weather conditions for operating the ship.
  • Completes deck planning to verify sufficient space on the platform to receive the cargo.
  • Sends loading instructions to the Supply Base team to verify that priority cargo is accessible (without selective collection). When there is transshipment from the platform, verifies available space.
  • Determines the specific loading order for the platform to collect the casing pipes in the correct sequence.
  • Maintains contact with the Drilling Engineer for the deck layout in casing loading (slick and centered) to verify the correct collection sequence on the platform.
  • Maintains contact with the Platform Stability section for any Variable Deck Loading (VDL) issues, which determines what can be collected on the platform.
  • Maintains contact with the Mud Engineer for all bulk loadings, considering pit space, which may be limited on the platform.
  • Monitors the availability of empty buckets for ship and bucket operations, as this impacts VDL; it calculates the number of full containers for VDL (Very Daily Load) and replaces full containers with empty ones to maintain availability on the platform.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience in offshore logistics, specifically in offshore oil and gas operations.
  • English advanced
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Kabal (Wellit).
  • In-depth knowledge of deepwater drilling and completion operations, associated equipment, common suppliers, platform management on a mobile offshore drilling unit, and logistics involved in performing well work.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Nossa área de Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços.

Nós somos responsáveis por uma infraestrutura gigantesca que atende aos principais produtos de vídeo da Globo, como o Globoplay, Premiere e os Canais Globo. Além disso, somos responsáveis pela transmissão ao vivo de grandes eventos - desde os campeonatos estaduais de futebol, a Copa do Mundo, Olimpíadas, Rock in Rio e até as câmeras ao vivo do Big Brother Brasil, que fica disponível 24x7 para todos os assinantes do Globoplay.

Desafios estratégicos

O mercado de mídia e entretenimento vive numa constante transformação, com variadas formas, comportamentos, plataformas e monetização do consumo de conteúdo. Múltiplas empresas de diferentes segmentos competem pela atenção e pelo bolso do consumidor e dos anunciantes. Essa constante transformação vem muito da própria evolução da tecnologia no mundo.

Nesse cenário, a Globo vem buscando diferentes segmentos de audiência, novos produtos, novas estratégias de distribuição, novas formas de operar e novos modelos de negócio.

Para suportar tanta transformação, precisamos entender os movimentos da indústria, o mercado cliente, a nossa estratégia de negócio, as tendências de tecnologia, nossas alavancas e nossos gaps.

Projetar novas capacidades de tecnologia, transformar algumas e, buscar inovação e parcerias, se faz absolutamente necessário.

Atuação de Arquitetura

A Arquitetura de Tecnologia da Globo, busca profissionais que possam trabalhar na interseção entre estratégia de negócio, tecnologia e a execução.

A área tem a missão de desenhar e propor estratégias, arquiteturas e roadmaps de evolução tecnológica para diversos domínios de negócio e foundations de tecnologia da empresa.

Faz isso com uma abordagem focada nos principais desafios transformacionais da empresa, nos níveis estratégico e tático e de maneira muito colaborativa com outras áreas de tecnologia e do negócio.

A área se estrutura nos papéis de arquitetura corporativa, arquitetura de soluções e arquitetura de dados & IA.

Traga sua experiência em benchmarks da indústria, mapas de capacidades, arquiteturas de referência, análises de gaps e buy or build e, construção de visões de futuro e roadmaps de tecnologia.

O que a área te oferece

  • Vai conduzir trabalhos de grande visibilidade que influenciam decisões estratégicas de tecnologia
  • Você vai ter um conhecimento amplo da empresa e da indústria de mídia
  • Vai desenvolver um olhar transversal e estratégico entre as capacidades de negócio e tecnológicas de toda a empresa

Posição de Arquitetura de Dados & IA

Esta posição irá ajudar a evoluir a arquitetura fundacional de dados & IA da Globo, que habilita os workloads de analytics, machine learning, generative AI e agentic AI.

Modelo de trabalho

Híbrido (RJ ou SP)

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Projetar a evolução da arquitetura da plataforma de dados e analytics;
  • Projetar a evolução da arquitetura da plataforma de IA (ML, GenAI, Agentic AI);
  • Projetar a evolução da arquitetura de governança de dados & AI;
  • Mapear e continuamente avaliar o landscape de vendors de tecnologia;
  • Rastrear tendências de dados & IA e transformar em oportunidades para evolução da arquitetura;
  • Conduzir assessments e benchmarks de tecnologia;
  • Construir e evoluir frameworks de capabilities e arquiteturas de referência.

Os resultados imediatos do trabalho desta posição são decisões que vão influenciar a esteira de execução. Portanto, diferentemente de uma área de delivery de software ou operação, as mudanças são sentidas no médio e longo prazo.

Requisitos e qualificações

Do que você precisa:

  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Formação superior ou pós-graduação em tecnologia, dados ou IA;
  • Experiência profissional prévia com dados & IA.

Conhecimentos que te destacam:

  • Atuação prévia em arquitetura;
  • Conhecimento do stack de dados & IA do Google;
  • Capacidade de entender e comunicar desafios complexos com clareza, estruturando mensagens de forma objetiva e adaptada a diferentes públicos.

title: Manager, Access Management Cluster
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC2027) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

The Position

Reporting to the Access Management Senior Manager, you will be a key member of the FIFA WOMEN’S WORLD CUP 2027 Access Management team. You will be responsible for developing and implementing the Access Management operations for all the official venues across the tournament within Brasil, in line with Access Management policies and procedures. Through close coordination with other Functional Area (FA) and venue managers, you will ensure that the operations relating to the key movements of persons holding a FIFA access device into and within their official venues meets the requirements and provide efficient, safe, and well-planned ingress, circulation & egress. The Access Management Cluster Manager will assist the Access Management Senior Manager by supporting the Access Management Venue Managers in the preparation stages of the tournament with the possibility of then assuming the position of Access Management Venue Manager of the Rio de Janeiro Stadium during the tournament. You will ensure security personnel and other responsible staff are provided with the necessary information, training and tools to operate access control effectively at each required location.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversight, training and support to the Access Management Venue Managers across all official venues including Stadia, Broadcast Centre, Venue Specific Hotels, and Training Sites.
  • Implementation and operation of Access Management policies and procedures for accredited individuals in line with the accreditation and safety and security concepts for the tournament, including access control point setup and entitlement resolution.
  • Planning and mapping of key client group flows, vertical transportation and ingress points onto venue maps and communication of flows and ingress points to all client groups via the provision of access tours, maps and briefings.
  • Ensuring all client group flows, paths of travel, entrances and exits planned for people with disabilities and/or limited mobility meet FIFA and related local Accessibility standards and requirements.
  • Provision of key wayfinding information as required to FIFA Dressing & Signage to ensure wayfinding on site is correct and as per all client group flows. Ensure that all wayfinding meets FIFA Accessibility standards and requirements.
  • Facilitate additional and exceptional access requirements onsite and assist all client groups with any access related issues.
  • Ensuring all Functional Areas (FAs) at the venues can locate their working areas and know how to reach them, within the constraints of privilege zoning and restrictions.
  • Ensuring all access staff and volunteers are trained and fully understand their roles and function and can perform the duties expected of them.

Your Profile

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or similar level of higher education in IT & Systems, Sport Venue Management, Safety and Security or similar.
  • If experience is compensating, lower degree is welcome to apply.
  • Football access management knowledge.
  • FIFA access management knowledge is a plus.
  • Effective interpersonal communication, influencing and negotiation skills.
  • Strong problem solving and analytical skills.
  • Stature and professional experience necessary to interact as tough partner with senior colleagues.
  • Good judgement, superb integrity, maturity, and fairness in dealing with people.

Experience

  • Minimum experience of 2 years in the sport event industry, preferably within access management, accreditation, safety and security or venue management. Experience within FIFA is an advantage.
  • Operation and setup of complex access control systems within ticketing and/or accreditation.
  • Wayfinding and route planning in a stadium environment.
  • Single-sport, multi-venue event experience.
  • Management and leadership of a team in high pressure tournament operations.
  • Demonstratable ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and under pressure.

Requirements

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work‑life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our team and take ownership of building and maintaining scalable data pipelines and infrastructure. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, can work independently, and enjoys collaborating across teams to deliver reliable solutions. You will be the primary data engineer, working closely with leadership, DevOps, research, and customer support to ensure that data flows are efficient, secure, and optimized for business needs.

You will have the opportunity to design, implement, and maintain systems that directly impact company operations, from ETL processes to data modeling and analytics readiness. The role requires strong problem‑solving skills, a proactive mindset, and the ability to adapt to shifting priorities in a startup‑style environment. If you are passionate about data engineering, comfortable collaborating across time zones, and eager to take ownership of impactful solutions, this position offers the chance to make a meaningful contribution and grow within a high‑performing team.

  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of solutions
  • Previous experience in small company or startup environments
  • Comfort working as the sole data engineer and collaborating with multiple teams
  • Open to overlapping with Pacific and Hong Kong time zones for QA/debugging

Nice to Have

  • Experience with PostgreSQL (or other relational databases)

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to contribute to our vision and development of Agentic AI tooling and platforms through technical leadership and proactive thinking. Our product is an orchestration platform that enables developers to spin up isolated, AI-powered development sessions that autonomously work on tasks - from Jira tickets to GitHub issues. The team operates without a dedicated product manager; you will be expected to identify problems worth solving, define requirements, and own features from problem statement to production deployment.

Our technical stack spans Rust for CLI tools and API server, React 19 with TypeScript for our frontend, and Kubernetes with Helm on Google Cloud for infrastructure. You will work across this entire stack, leveraging the agentic tooling we build ourselves to contribute effectively beyond your primary domain. Your specialization in backend development - API design, async web frameworks, authentication, databases, and service architecture - will make you the team’s anchor for the API server and backend systems, but you will regularly touch frontend code and infrastructure as the work demands.

The team operates in a startup fashion with a heavy focus on experimentation and prototyping solutions first and evaluating what works in practice rather than heavy upfront requirements given how quickly the agentic space moves.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Make decisions based on multiple quality dimensions like user impact, failure tolerance, code maintenance, implementation time, security breaches, and performance.
  • Implement quality gates and improve agentic-driven processes and workflows.
  • Collaborate on novel ideas to improve the team processes.
  • Lead initiatives and own subproducts and feature development from problem statement and specification to production deployment.
  • Care for and monitor the quality of our product.

title: Sr. Finance Systems Analyst
description:
Position Summary

The Senior Finance Analyst – Clinical Solutions Portfolio is a strategic, business-partnering role responsible for portfolio-level financial analysis across Clinical Solutions departments. The primary focus is project and portfolio financial health, including forecasting, budget performance, and financial controls, with an expanding remit into trial operations KPIs and measures as they relate to budget integrity, scope control, and delivery efficiency.

The role requires a strong background in Project Finance within a CRO environment , excellent analytical and presentation skills, and the ability to engage credibly with department heads and senior operational leaders.

Main Duties & Responsibilities

  • Own and deliver portfolio-level financial analysis for Clinical Solutions departments, including budget health, forecast accuracy, margin performance, and risk identification.
  • Lead project financial oversight across the full project lifecycle, from award through closeout, ensuring adherence to financial best practices and internal controls.
  • Perform variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) to identify drivers of change, scope creep, and emerging risks.
  • Partner with project finance teams to ensure consistency and integrity of project-level data feeding portfolio reporting.
  • Support and enhance departmental forecasting and planning processes using clear, supportable assumptions.
  • Monitor budget consumption, earned value indicators, and change order impacts across portfolios.
  • Provide forward-looking insights to support proactive financial decision-making by operational leadership.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of financial processes, controls, and reporting standards.
  • Develop and maintain trial operations KPIs and measures that link operational performance to financial outcomes (e.g., enrollment pace vs. burn, milestone progress vs. revenue, site activity vs. cost).
  • Leverage Excel and Power BI to create scalable dashboards and analyses that support portfolio governance and executive review.
  • Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights for non-finance stakeholders.
  • Act as a trusted finance partner to Clinical Solutions department heads, supporting planning, performance reviews, and strategic initiatives.
  • Prepare and deliver high-quality presentations and executive-ready materials summarizing portfolio performance, risks, and recommendations.
  • Support ad hoc analyses and special projects requested by Finance leadership, Clinical Operations leadership, or executive management.
  • Collaborate closely with Project Management, Clinical Operations, Data Management, and Finance teams to ensure alignment between operational execution and financial reporting.

Minimum Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree (or its international equivalent) + 5 years of related experience.

Preferred Education & Experience (optional)

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field (or its international equivalent).
  • Approximately 5-8 years of relevant experience in project finance, FP&A, or operational finance, with a strong preference for CRO or clinical research industry experience.
  • Demonstrated experience managing or analysing clinical trial portfolios and complex project financials.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (financial modelling, scenario analysis, large data sets).
  • Working knowledge of Power BI or similar BI/visualization tools.
  • Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leaders and department heads.
  • Solid understanding of clinical trial financial drivers, project lifecycles, and contract/budget mechanics.

Knowledge, Skills & Competencies

  • Strong financial and analytical acumen with the ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes.
  • Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior operational leaders.
  • Ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations.
  • High attention to detail balanced with a portfolio-level, strategic mindset.
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

  • Levantar e gerenciar os requisitos legais nas fases de comissionamento do projeto, subsequente ao condicionamento das instalações, caracterizada pela introdução gradativa de carga acompanhada dos necessários ajustes e regulagens, de modo a atingir condições estáveis de segurança e operação da Unidade, visando a prevenção de vazamentos, incêndios e explosões.

  • Fiscalizar os requisitos da NBR 15.595, quanto a Alpinismo Industrial.
  • Levantar e gerenciar os requisitos legais, verificando os procedimentos estabelecidos para as atividades críticas (altura, espaço confinado, movimentação de cargas, energias perigosas, radiografia industrial, entre outros).
  • Fiscalizar os requisitos mínimos e as medidas de proteção para o trabalho em altura, envolvendo o planejamento, a organização e a execução, de forma a garantir a segurança e a saúde dos trabalhadores envolvidos direta ou indiretamente com esta atividade.
  • Realizar simulado de emergência de trabalho em altura, visando representar, de forma real, um determinado cenário acidental e a implementação, das ações de resposta para controle de emergência, registrando em relatório o resultado da análise crítica e ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Realizar auditoria comportamental, aplicando método de observação e interação com a força de trabalho, com foco na atitude e no comportamento das pessoas durante a realização de suas tarefas, através de uma técnica de abordagem positiva e focando na conscientização e na melhoria contínua do desempenho em SMS da força de trabalho, registrando em sistemas informatizados da Petrobras.
  • Realizar auditoria de práticas seguras, registrando o grau de aderência da força de trabalho às normas e às boas práticas de SMS na execução de tarefas dentro de uma determinada área de trabalho através do indicador percentual Índice de Práticas Seguras (IPS), registrando em sistemas informatizados do cliente.
  • Verificar em campo se os procedimentos estabelecidos para as atividades críticas (altura, espaço confinado, movimentação de cargas, energias perigosas, radiografia industrial, entre outros) estão sendo cumpridos e avaliar a adequação entre o procedimento e a prática, registrando conforme orientação do cliente.

Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho.

Experiência Desejável: 06 anos ou mais em atividades relacionadas com atuação na indústria de energia (óleo, gás, termoelétricas, entre outras), química/petroquímica, multinacionais-certificadoras ou montagem industrial de grande ou médio porte.

title: Accreditation Client Group Coordinator
description:
Accreditation Client Group Coordinator

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Accreditation Client Group Manager, the Accreditation Client Group Coordinator supports the planning, coordination, and operational delivery of accreditation services for designated client groups for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

Working closely with Client Group Managers, Accreditation Systems, Security, Venue teams, and other functional areas, the role focuses on data accuracy, process execution, stakeholder support, and operational readiness.

The position plays a critical role in ensuring that client group accreditation applications are processed correctly, access rights are applied accurately, and services are delivered in line with FIFA accreditation policies and service standards.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Client Group Support & Coordination

  • Support accreditation delivery for assigned client groups, such as volunteers, suppliers, commercial partners, workforce, or other tournament stakeholders.
  • Assist in collecting, reviewing, and validating client group accreditation data in line with eligibility criteria and submission timelines.
  • Maintain regular communication with client group contacts to provide guidance on accreditation requirements, processes, and deadlines.
  • Coordinate closely with Client Group Managers to support overall client group readiness and service delivery.

Accreditation Process Execution

  • Support the end‑to‑end accreditation process for assigned client groups, including application tracking, data validation, approval support, badge status monitoring, and distribution preparation.
  • Assist with the accurate assignment and verification of access rights in accordance with FIFA zoning concepts, venue access matrices, and security protocols.
  • Monitor application progress and highlight issues, inconsistencies, or risks to the Client Group Manager.

Stakeholder & Functional Area Support

  • Assist in liaising with FIFA and FIFA27 functional areas to communicate accreditation guidelines and data requirements.
  • Support the preparation of guidance materials, instructions, and training documentation for client groups and venue teams.
  • Provide operational support to venue accreditation teams as required.

Event-Time Operations

  • Support the operation of Accreditation Centres and badge distribution points during test events and tournament time.
  • Assist with client service at accreditation centres, including troubleshooting data issues and supporting badge collection processes.
  • Support coordination with Security, Venue Operations, and Accreditation Operations teams to address access‑related issues promptly.
  • Escalate operational issues or irregularities to the Client Group Manager in a timely manner.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate records of client group accreditation statistics, issues, and resolutions.
  • Support regular reporting on volumes, progress, and operational status.
  • Assist with post‑event reporting, lessons learned, and knowledge transfer activities.

YOUR PROFILE

Education & Experience

  • University degree or equivalent experience in Event Management, Operations, Sports Administration, or a related field.
  • 1–2 years of experience in accreditation, event operations, data coordination, or client‑facing roles.
  • Experience working in major events or large‑scale operational environments is an advantage.
  • Exposure to accreditation systems or access control processes is a plus.

Skills & Competencies

  • High attention to detail and strong organisational skills.
  • Strong data handling and administrative accuracy.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in fast‑paced, time‑critical, and multicultural environments.
  • Ability to follow defined processes and elevate issues appropriately.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and online collaboration tools.

Requirements

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

description:
Overview

Voldex is a leading gaming company focused on Roblox, the most exciting ecosystem in gaming today. We are home to several of Roblox's top games, including Brookhaven, Driving Empire, and NFL Universe Football. With over 160 million monthly active players across our games, we are the #1 Roblox developer by audience size. Founded in 2015, we have since grown to 85+ full-time remote team members across the globe.

Our strategy is to acquire and sustainably grow games on Roblox. Our acquisition strategy is backed with significant capital from firms including The Raine Group, Makers Fund, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), QIA, Dune Ventures, and MIT.

Our top games include:

  • Brookhaven, #1 Roleplay game on Roblox and the most popular game on the Roblox platform
  • Driving Empire, the #1 Driving game on Roblox where we’ve brought real cars into the game in partnership with automakers
  • NFL Universe Football, the #1 American football game and top grossing sports game on Roblox.

We’re looking for a Concept Artist to help shape the visual future of Brookhaven — one of the largest and most beloved experiences on Roblox. In this role, you’ll drive early-stage visual exploration across characters, environments, props, and in-game experiences, creating concept art that not only reflects Brookhaven’s distinct style but also translates seamlessly into game-ready assets. You’ll partner closely with our Art Lead, 3D artists, and game designers to bring ideas to life quickly and iteratively. Beyond supporting the game, you’ll also play a key role in evolving Brookhaven as a growing franchise, contributing to the development of ownable visual elements, refining our art direction, and helping build a cohesive, scalable visual identity across the entire world.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop high-quality concept art for environments, props, characters, and in-game mockups.
  • Help define and uphold the visual style of Brookhaven across all elements, including UI, environments, props, and characters.
  • Interpret the project’s creative vision, contribute to art direction, and bring forward new ideas and explorations.
  • Create and maintain a living Visual Style Guide, ensuring alignment and clear communication with stakeholders on design decisions.
  • Produce concepts that translate effectively into game-ready assets and support scalable, franchiseable content.
  • Build a strong understanding of the game’s universe and technical constraints to inform design decisions.
  • Partner closely with 3D artists to provide paint-overs and iterate on assets, refining and elevating final visual quality and initial direction.

Who You Are

  • A strong portfolio showcasing concept art across environments, props, characters, and location development
  • Professional experience in a creative field, or equivalent freelance/personal project work
  • Proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar tools
  • A deep appreciation for Brookhaven’s art style, with the ability to execute consistently within its visual direction
  • Experience balancing artistic vision with technical constraints, ensuring concepts translate effectively into gameplay-ready assets
  • Skilled in creating iterative concept packages (e.g., mood boards, callout sheets, paint-overs) that support downstream asset creation
  • Strong creative instincts, with the ability to elevate assets while respecting established direction
  • A versatile concepting skill set, with the ability to produce a wide range of asset types quickly (e.g., characters, iconography, POIs, props)

Nice to Have

  • Experience working across both game and franchise/IP-driven concept art
  • Cross-disciplinary understanding of design, UX, or gameplay systems to align visuals with function
  • Familiarity with Roblox as a platform — either as a creator or an active player with a strong understanding of its ecosystem
  • Experience with 3D concepting tools (e.g., Blender, Maya, etc.)
  • Working knowledge of Roblox Studio

Location

  • Remote / Timezone: EST or PST working hours required
  • Travel: 2-3x / year (RDC + team meet-ups)
  • Hiring Regions: Canada, LATAM, UK

Voldex is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status

Permanent Voldex employees enjoy the following benefits:

  • Competitive compensation - above-market salary + profit sharing + stock options
  • Retirement benefits - company contribution to your retirement plan (401k, RRSP, Pension), in Canada, UK and USA
  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits - depending on the country, there may be additional benefits (Life, ADD, etc…) such as Canada, UK and USA
  • Flexible PTO - vacations + Federal / Bank Holidays
  • Remote First - we have always been remote and will remain that way including work from home/anywhere
  • In-person get-togethers, virtual company-wide game events, Robux allowances, and so much more
  • Professional Development - Reimburse the costs of courses, materials, and anything to help further their training and growth
  • Work with awesome people and impact millions of daily players

We are looking for a professional to fill the Turnaround Engineer position at our office in Flamengo, Rio de Janeiro.

  • Coordinate planning activities, ensuring engineering, procurement, and construction schedules are met, and ensuring project goals are achieved through detailed planning and resource management.
  • Contribute to the vessels’ POB Plan by analyzing and validating the Maintenance Service Forecast, as well as monitoring the integrated maintenance plan.
  • Lead the execution of the Operations and Organization Project, playing a proactive role in problem resolution and prevention and in identifying potential risk factors that may impact the schedule, while identifying, managing, and controlling changes.
  • Ensure technical and operational alignment by participating in technical review meetings with the client.
  • Prepare and conduct kick‑off meetings, ensuring a clear overview of the projects, adherence to the HSE strategy, information about the unit, planning facilities, previously identified risks, opportunities, and lessons learned from other projects within the unit and fleet.
  • Ensure that MODEC fleet turnaround projects are planned and executed in an optimized and integrated manner (SPIE Activities, Measurement, Design, Operations, External Clients, etc.), through the development of Master Project Schedules and Project Execution Schedules, defining the project histogram, and defining/freezing project scopes.
  • Lead the coordination of offshore activities during the execution phase by monitoring and reporting on project progress, tracking adherence to deadlines, costs, and delivery quality, and providing support to project coordinators with timely responses in the event of identified anomalies or unexpected events, in addition to providing corporate support whenever necessary.
  • Collaborate on the development of Lessons Learned, preparing, issuing, and presenting close‑out reports containing all relevant information and knowledge gained from the projects to identify opportunities for improvement for future development and knowledge sharing across the fleet, and closing all turnaround Work Orders in the CMMS.
  • Ensure the return of all equipment, tools, and materials belonging to contractors and suppliers, and properly monitor all cases.
  • Execute project Risk Assessment and Risk Management processes, conducting Risk Assessment brainstorming sessions with the necessary stakeholders, compiling and analyzing all identified risks, issuing the Risk Register, identifying potential Response Plan actions, and monitoring the progress of these actions.
  • Ensure that all systems/equipment are restored to normal performance after project completion and properly handed over to operations.
  • Establish coordination with internal and external stakeholders (other company departments, clients, suppliers, etc.) and/or external clients, preparing and conducting periodic meetings to align planning, details, and requirements of project activities and present project progress.
  • Monitor the execution phase of the planned scope on-site, participating in daily meetings with project stakeholders and PICs.
  • Plan and monitor the project preparation phase, including scaffolding setup, material segregation (onshore and offshore), submission of weekly reports to project stakeholders, and presentation of progress meetings.
  • Coordinate with the onshore and offshore teams regarding equipment mobilization for the project: shipment of contractor containers and utilities for offshore execution.

Requirements and qualifications

Requirements:

  • A bachelor’s degree in engineering is required. A master’s degree in a related field is a plus.
  • CREA certification is mandatory.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in on‑site construction supervision.
  • Offshore experience is preferred.
  • Experience with maintenance shutdowns is a plus.
  • Basic proficiency in Power BI.
  • Intermediate proficiency in Excel.
  • Advanced English.
  • Intermediate proficiency in SAP MM and PM.
  • Willingness to travel frequently.

title: DevOps Security Engineer
description:
About Legacy

Legacy is an easy-to-use, non-custodial Web3 wallet designed to protect digital assets through beneficiary protection and seamless DeFi access. Users can swap across chains, earn yield in one click, and safeguard wealth for the next generation.

About the Software Division

We are building a portfolio of software products inside the Decentralized Masters ecosystem, including:

  • Legacy Wallet - a non-custodial Web3 wallet with beneficiary protection and seamless DeFi access
  • Trading Bot - automated crypto execution tools for serious investors
  • Future fintech and investor infrastructure tools

We are now building the retention and lifecycle engine that will power long‑term recurring revenue across all products.

About The Role

You will be the single person responsible for the security of a platform that tracks hundreds of millions in digital assets. That is the job. Everything else is secondary.

We need someone who breaks things for a living. Someone who looks at a login page and sees six attack vectors. Someone who reads a pull request and catches the injection vulnerability that two senior developers missed. Someone who lies awake thinking about the phishing campaign that hasn’t been invented yet. If that sounds exhausting, this is not your role. If that sounds like Tuesday, keep reading.

Your primary responsibilities are security and quality assurance. You own penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, threat modeling, automated test frameworks, and CI quality gates across every product we ship. You also own infrastructure: AWS, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and incident response. And because we are a small, senior team, you will write production code when security and QA responsibilities are covered. You are not a consultant or a checkbox auditor. You are an engineer who ships, and whose code happens to make everything else harder to break.

The ideal candidate has spent time at major product‑driven fintech and crypto companies where a single security failure can destroy user trust overnight.

Security (Primary)

  • Own the security posture across all products: Legacy, Trading Bot, and future platforms. If something gets breached, it is your problem. If nothing gets breached, it is because of your work
  • Conduct regular penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, and threat modeling aligned with OWASP standards and methodologies
  • Ensure full coverage of the OWASP Top 10 in application security testing, code reviews, and deployment checks
  • Perform security‑focused code reviews across frontend, backend, and infrastructure code, catching what standard code reviews miss
  • Implement and manage secrets management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or KMS), access controls, and least‑privilege policies
  • Build and maintain incident response playbooks. When something breaks, you lead the response, run the post‑mortem, and ship the fix
  • Stay ahead of Web3 and crypto‑specific attack vectors: phishing campaigns, wallet exploits, API key compromises, supply chain attacks, and social engineering
  • Manage and coordinate external security audits and penetration tests from third‑party firms

Quality Assurance & Testing (Primary)

  • Design and implement test strategies across all products: unit tests, integration tests, end‑to‑end tests, API tests, and regression suites
  • Build and maintain automated testing frameworks and CI quality gates that prevent broken code from reaching production
  • Define and track quality metrics: test coverage, flakiness rate, regression detection latency, and bug escape rate
  • Write and execute security test cases: authentication flows, authorization controls, input validation, API abuse scenarios, and edge cases around financial data
  • Perform both white‑box and black‑box testing, leveraging full codebase access to catch issues that surface‑level QA would miss
  • Test across the full stack: frontend UI, backend APIs, database queries, third‑party integrations, and on‑chain interactions

Infrastructure & DevOps (Foundation)

  • Maintain and improve cloud infrastructure on AWS using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation)
  • Own CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions preferred): automated testing, security scanning, linting, and deployment
  • Harden infrastructure: network security, IAM policies, container security, and environment isolation
  • Build logging, monitoring, and alerting across all services (CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent)
  • Ensure audit trails for user actions, system changes, and access events
  • Manage production reliability, incident response, and cost optimization

Fullstack Development (When the fortress is secure)

  • Contribute production code across frontend and backend, bringing a security‑first mindset to every feature you build
  • Build features, fix bugs, and ship improvements alongside the engineering team
  • Every line you write should make the product better and harder to break: input validation, error handling, authentication, and data protection by default
  • Participate in architecture discussions and code reviews, advocating for testability, reliability, and security in every decision

Requirements

Required

  • 5+ years in software engineering roles with meaningful, hands‑on security and QA experience. We will verify this. If your security experience is theoretical, this is not the right fit
  • Fullstack development experience: you can build and ship features across frontend (React or equivalent) and backend (Node.js, Python, Go, or equivalent)
  • Hands‑on penetration testing and vulnerability assessment experience across web applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure
  • Strong working knowledge of OWASP standards, including the OWASP Top 10, OWASP Testing Guide, and OWASP secure coding practices
  • Experience building automated test frameworks and integrating testing into CI/CD pipelines
  • AWS expertise (EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, CloudFront, WAF)
  • Infrastructure as Code experience (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi)
  • Container technologies: Docker and Kubernetes in production environments
  • Scripting and automation proficiency in Bash and Python
  • Experience with secrets management tools (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or similar)
  • Familiarity with security and testing tools (Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Selenium, Cypress, Jest, Postman, or equivalent)
  • Strong communication skills: you can explain security risks and quality tradeoffs clearly to non‑technical stakeholders

Nice‑to‑Have

  • Security certifications: OSCP, CISSP, CompTIA Security+, AWS Security Specialty, or equivalent
  • Experience at a crypto, DeFi, Web3, or fintech product company (Coinbase, Phantom, Stripe, Casa, MetaMask, Zerion, Ramp, or similar)
  • Familiarity with Web3‑specific security concerns: wallet security, key management, on‑chain monitoring, phishing mitigation
  • SDET background or experience in a hybrid development‑and‑testing role
  • Experience testing financial systems: payment flows, ledger integrity, double‑spend prevention, or transaction monitoring
  • Experience implementing zero‑trust architectures
  • Bug bounty participation, CVE publications, or contributions to open‑source security tooling

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary + performance‑based incentives tied to retention & LTV improvement
  • Direct exposure to founders
  • Team Offsites
  • Remote work
  • High ownership, high‑impact role

As a Legal Counsel Customs and Export Controls Governance (m/f/d) , you will contribute to the legal backbone of Fresenius Medical Care’s global trade operations. This is an exciting opportunity to grow within a dynamic legal environment and make a meaningful impact on global healthcare logistics.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provide legal advice, counsel and guidance and on a range of trade governance matters such as customs and export controls, free trade agreements, special customs regimes and related risk management issues.

  • Collaboration with stakeholders and the Customs and Export Controls Governance team for assessing training needs.

  • Support in the development for automation of trade-related processes and activities.

Education

  • Fully qualified lawyer, incl. above-average university degree.

Experience and Required Skills

  • 8+ years experience in customs and export controls in an international law firm and/or in-house legal department of an internationally operating and complex corporation, specializing in customs and export control matters.
  • Preferred Master’s degree or equivalent.
  • Experience in roll-out and implementation of customs and export control policies, processes and trainings.
  • Ideally, experience in the healthcare sector.

Technical Skills

  • Good knowledge of global trade, including customs, and export control laws and regulations.
  • Knowledge of relevant commercial, tax and supply chain processes.
  • Ability to understand and apply regulatory requirements to business operations.
  • Experience with relevant trade compliance tools or willingness to learn.

Soft Skills

Descrição da vaga

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

O movimento da vida gera resultados e também resíduos.

Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor e possível continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento.

Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio .

Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.

Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.

Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

title: Collections & Accounts Receivable Manager
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff ‘for fit’ makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Job Purpose

The Collections & Accounts Receivable Manager oversees university‑wide past‑due account management, directs internal and external collections efforts, and ensures compliance with federal, state, and institutional regulations. The role monitors aging, resolves complex account issues, manages payment plans, supports audits, and collaborates with campus partners to maintain accurate, student‑centered financial operations.

Supervisory Authority

Direct report – Collections Analyst

Nature And Scope

Work closely with internal and external stakeholders.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Oversee the full lifecycle of student accounts receivable, including monitoring balances, aging, past‑due accounts, and collections activity across all student populations.
  • Lead internal and external collections efforts, including coordination with third‑party collection agencies, federal loan servicers, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely and compliant recovery of outstanding balances.
  • Develop, implement, and refine collections strategies, outreach protocols, payment arrangement guidelines, and escalation pathways that align with university policy and regulatory requirements.
  • Provide high‑level review of student accounts requiring specialized consideration— including financial hardship, bankruptcy, deceased student cases, fraud concerns, and payment disputes—and recommend appropriate actions.
  • Collaborate with external vendors and internal team including Financial Aid, Registrar, Treasury, and General Accounting to address account discrepancies, apply adjustments, and resolve issues affecting student billing or aid eligibility.
  • Maintain accurate and organized documentation of collections activity, payment plans, communications, and account adjustments to support compliance, audit readiness, and institutional reporting.
  • Prepare and analyze regular collections, aging, and performance reports for leadership, identifying trends, risks, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Oversee and support the design and execution of payment plans, including eligibility review, approval workflows, and monitoring adherence to established terms.
  • Ensure compliance with FERPA, FDCPA, federal and state regulations, and institutional policies governing billing and collections activities.
  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, internal workflows, staff training materials, and quality‑control measures to promote consistency and continuous improvement.
  • Provide coaching, guidance, and support to collections staff, helping them strengthen customer‑service skills, documentation accuracy, and regulatory awareness.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex student or family inquiries, providing clear, professional, and empathetic guidance while maintaining institutional integrity and compliance.

Core Competencies

  • Accounts Receivable & Collections Management
  • Regulatory & Compliance Knowledge
  • Data Analysis & Reporting
  • Complex Problem Solving
  • Communication & Student‑Centered Service

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree required, a degree in business, finance, accounting, public administration, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 3–5 years of progressively responsible experience in student accounts, collections, accounts receivable, billing, loan servicing, or a related financial operations environment.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of federal, state, and institutional regulations related to billing and collections (e.g., FERPA, FDCPA, Title IV implications, state collection laws).
  • Experience managing, monitoring, and analyzing aging reports, receivables trends, and collections performance metrics.
  • Proven ability to resolve complex account issues involving financial aid, registration, refunds, payment plans, and account adjustments.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage professionally and empathetically with students, families, and campus partners.
  • Experience working with ERP systems (Workday preferred) and comfort using reporting tools to extract, interpret, and present financial data.

Investigate and maintain records of all work-related injuries and/or illnesses, provide statistical analyses, and assist department management in developing effective health and safety measures to continuously improve safety objectives.

What if your adversarial mindset and attack intuition could directly influence how AI understands and reasons about cybersecurity threats? This is not an exploit development role. It's about structured thinking — analyzing kill chains, identifying where defenses break down, and clearly articulating how risk propagates across complex systems.   • Able to map adversary behavior clearly and explain it to both technical and non‑technical audiences
  • Naturally analytical and methodical — you see systems the way attackers do

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain, or STRIDE

  • Background in cloud security, network security, or application security
  • Prior exposure to AI security, adversarial ML, or security data labeling
  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, CEH, GPEN, or similar

Why Join Us

  • Work directly on frontier AI systems alongside world‑leading research labs
  • Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you

  • Apply your offensive security expertise to a genuinely novel and high‑impact domain
