title: Manager, Ceremonies
description:
Manager, Ceremonies

Department: Events & Entertainment Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 hosting in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

THE POSITION

The Ceremonies Manager supports the end to end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments.

Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, the Ceremonies Manager supports the planning and operational delivery of all official ceremonies, working closely with the Senior Manager and wider Entertainment team to ensure alignment with FIFA’s vision, brand standards. The role supports and coordinates the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027, ensuring that all ceremonies are executed in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA.

Working closely with the Entertainment Team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Manager supports the Senior Manager in coordinating the operational delivery of ceremonies, contributing to creative and operational review processes and helping ensure the execution of iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage.

Key Responsibilities

Ceremonies Project Leadership
  • Support the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA.
  • Support the end to end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament.
  • Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through pre production, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover.
  • Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams.
  • Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables.
  • Provide senior decision making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation.
  • Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC.
  • Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into match day and event day operations.
  • Escalate ceremony related operational matters.
  • Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy.
Team Leadership
  • Support the Ceremonies Team by contributing to day‑to‑day coordination, operational readiness, and delivery standards.
  • Assist with the onboarding and support of Ceremonies personnel—including suppliers, freelancers, and event‑time workforce—helping ensure consistent standards and operational preparedness.
  • Contribute to internal talent development through daily guidance, structured feedback, and knowledge sharing.
  • Support effective collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units.
  • Contribute to coordination between venue‑based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution.
  • Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonies workstreams.
Major Ceremonies Oversight
  • Support the planning and delivery processes for all major ceremonial events, including Opening, Closing, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half‑Time Show (if applicable), and Pre‑Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament.
  • Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.
Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management
  • Support the development and refinement of the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony in collaboration with the Entertainment Team.
  • Contribute to the integration of host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful manner.
  • Assist in the creation of creative briefs, content commissioning, and preproduction workflows in coordination with internal teams and external agencies.
  • Contribute to stakeholder approval processes to ensure all content is delivered, documented, and archived in line with operational requirements.
  • Support IP and copyright compliance across all ceremony related content.
Planning Scheduling & Documentation
  • Maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams.
  • Ensure operational and creative decisions are fully documented and version controlled.
  • Coordinate with multiple suppliers, conduct regular update meetings, coordinate implementation processes, and supervise payments and reporting.
  • Prepare written and oral presentations, high‑level briefings, and reports for senior leadership and FIFA counterparts.
  • Organise and participate in Review, Project Team, and Status Update meetings.
  • Support the creation, management, and archiving of project plans, workflows, venue documentation, and readiness tools across all ceremony workstreams.
  • Contribute to ensuring readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and provide operational support on event days.
  • Support operational decision‑making to help maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies.
  • Assist with rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination for all ceremonies.
  • Support venue level pre‑production activities, including technical surveys, staging assessments, and infrastructure planning.
Supplier & Budget Management
  • Support procurement processes as directed by the Ceremonies Senior Manager, including supplier briefing and evaluation.
  • Manage day‑to‑day relationships with entertainment suppliers and contractors at assigned venue(s).
  • Assist with budget management tasks, including forecasting inputs, cost tracking, variation documentation, and invoice processing, ensuring accuracy and timely follow‑up.
  • Help monitor contractual deliverables and timelines, ensuring they remain aligned with pre‑production schedules and operational readiness requirements, and escalates risks to the Senior Manager as needed.
Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison
  • Act as a liaison between the Ceremonies Team and all relevant Functional Areas, including Venue Operations, Broadcast, Safety & Security, Marketing, and FIFA SPE, in coordination with the Senior Manager.
  • Deliver concise briefings and alignment updates across all internal and external stakeholders.
  • Support the building and maintenance of relationships with Host Country national bodies, cultural organizations, and local partners contributing to ceremonies.
  • Ensure early phase cross‑functional integration to support seamless operational delivery.
Venue Readiness & Execution
  • Support preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), ceremony production schedules, and PMC rundowns.
  • Direct venue level pre‑production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, performer logistics, and infrastructure planning.
  • Contribute to ensuring readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and support execution on the day of each event.
  • Act as the key operational decision maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies.
  • Assist in rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Ensure all creative and technical elements are validated during pre‑event testing and rehearsal phases.
Other Duties
  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by management aligned with project delivery.
  • Represent the Ceremonies function in cross‑functional planning forums and management briefings.
  • Support the Head of Entertainment in strategic planning, operational readiness, and tournament‑wide entertainment integration.

Your Profile

Education:
  • Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience.
Experience
  • 5+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large‑scale public events.
  • Prior experience in a FIFA tournament or comparable major international sports event is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, large‑scale ceremonies including opening/closing ceremonies and awards presentations.
  • Proven track record in team managership, creative development, supplier management, and cross‑functional coordination.
  • Experience managing RFP/procurement processes and overseeing multi‑supplier contracts and budgets.
  • Experience integrating cultural programming and working with national cultural bodies and creative agencies.
Skills & Competencies
  • Administrative Skills: Ability to manage office and production documentation including RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately.
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high‑pressure environments.
  • Flexibility: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period.
  • Communication Skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level.
  • Organizational Skills: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines.
  • Problem‑Solving Skills: Strategic and creative approach to problem‑solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure.
  • Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals.
  • Interpersonal Skills: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross‑functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment
  • Cultural Sensitivity: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant.
  • Passion for Entertainment: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire.
Certifications & Requirements
  • Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools.
  • Experience of Monday.com an advantage.
  • Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus
  • The right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

  • Degree in Biology or related fields.
  • Python proficiency for numerical validation. MATLAB, R, C, SQL, Numpy, Pandas, SciPy, domain-specific libraries, Stata or knowledge of any programming language can be equivalent.
  • 2+ years of professional experience: applied, research, or teaching experience is applicable.
  • Experience with biological data analysis and algorithms.
  • Familiarity with bioinformatics tools and computational methods.
  • Strong written English (C1+).

How It Works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $14 per hour equivalent , depending on their level and pace of contribution. Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. title: Senior Manager, Stadium Entertainment
description:
Senior Manager, Stadium Entertainment

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

The Position

The Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager is responsible for leading the planning, development, and delivery of all Stadium Entertainment operations across the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, this role will oversee the full lifecycle of stadium entertainment activations across all tournament venues and IBCC, ensuring a consistent, high-quality and globally resonant fan experience.

This role ensures the successful implementation of the FIFA‑developed Stadium Entertainment Concept, overseeing creative, technical, and operational workstreams to deliver world‑class matchday entertainment experiences.

The position provides senior leadership, cross‑functional coordination, and operational oversight to ensure consistency, quality, and readiness.

The Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager will act as the primary point of contact for stadium entertainment matters across the tournament footprint, including the IBCC, working closely with venue teams, broadcast, and the FIFA Special Events & Entertainment (SPE) team to guarantee world‑class entertainment delivery at every match.

Key Responsibilities
  • Stadium Entertainment Project Leadership
    • Lead the operational delivery and implementation of the Stadium Entertainment Concept across all tournament venues in alignment with FIFA Entertainment (EET) in Zurich.
    • Oversee stadium‑specific pre‑production workflows including creative approvals, technical scoping, resource planning, and risk assessments.
    • Main point of contact with stadiums for LED screen specs and content delivery formats.
    • Ensure alignment of objectives, timelines, scopes, and approvals for all Stadium Entertainment activities.
    • Provide support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation for Stadium Entertainment.
    • Lead the operational planning and delivery of all stadium entertainment workstreams across all FWWC27 venues and IBCC.
    • Provide senior‑level oversight and escalation management for all Stadium Entertainment operational issues.
    • Lead the development of stadium entertainment operational plans, rundowns, and show formats for all venues.
    • Oversee implementation of the FIFA‑approved Entertainment Concept across all stadium entertainment touchpoints.
    • Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, FTI, and other Functional Areas to integrate entertainment seamlessly into match‑day operations.
    • Ensure consistency of fan experience and entertainment standards across the full tournament venue footprint.
  • IBCC Stadium Entertainment Project Leadership
    • Lead the Stadium Entertainment operation at the IBCC, overseeing all entertainment areas, operational structures, and functional setup within that environment.
    • Ensure the IBCC stadium entertainment programme is fully aligned with the broader tournament entertainment concept and operational standards.
    • Coordinate IBCC‑specific entertainment requirements with broadcast partners, venue management, and relevant Functional Areas.
    • Act as the primary point of contact for all stadium entertainment matters within the IBCC, managing suppliers and technical crews on site.
  • Team Leadership
    • Manage the Stadium Entertainment Team, providing clear direction, performance oversight, and accountability structures.
    • Mentor and support all Stadium Entertainment personnel, including full‑time staff, freelancers, and event‑time workforce, ensuring consistent standards, development pathways, and operational readiness across all staffing groups.
    • Support internal talent development through coaching and guidance.
    • Build team structures and optimise collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units.
    • Provide leadership and operational oversight to all Stadium Entertainment personnel working within the IBCC environment, ensuring clarity of roles, responsibilities, and communication flows.
    • Foster strong coordination between venue‑based teams and IBCC‑based teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution.
    • Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Ceremonies Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonial workstreams.
  • Venue Readiness & Execution
    • Lead preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), stadium production schedules, and PMC rundowns for Stadium Entertainment.
    • Oversee pre‑production processes including technical surveys, AV infrastructure assessments, and supplier installation planning.
    • Ensure readiness standards are met and oversee execution during live operations.
    • Act as the key problem‑solver to maintain seamless delivery during matchday entertainment.
    • Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals, and stakeholder coordination.
    • Ensure all entertainment elements are validated during pre‑event testing and rehearsal phases.
    • Direct venue‑level pre‑production processes including technical surveys, infrastructure assessments, and installation planning.
  • Content Production & Management
    • Coordinate delivery, approval, and archival of all entertainment content including music, graphics, video, and scripts.
    • Oversee creative brief development, content commissioning, and preproduction workflows with internal teams and external agencies.
    • Manage stakeholder approval pathways to ensure content is locked in accordance with operational timelines.
    • Work with the Head of Entertainment and FIFA SPE team to align creative execution with brand and communications guidelines.
    • Manage IP and copyright compliance for all entertainment content deployed at venues.
  • Planning Scheduling & Documentation
    • Oversee development of pre‑production timelines, milestone structures, and cross‑venue coordination processes for Stadium Entertainment.
    • Track and report delivery progress through detailed WIP reports and Project plan. Ensure all operational and creative decisions are documented and version‑controlled.
    • Prepare written and oral presentations, high‑level briefings and reports for Head of Entertainment, Senior leadership and FIFA counterparts.
    • Organise and participate in regular Review, Project Team, and Status Update meetings.
    • Report on project progress and stakeholder alignment to the Head of Entertainment.
    • Lead the creation, management, and archiving of project plans, workflows, venue documentation, and readiness tools across all Stadium Entertainment workstreams.
  • Supplier & Budget Management
    • Lead early‑stage budget modelling, scenario planning, and resourcing strategies to support creative and operational planning.
    • Develop and manage Scopes of Work, Procurement activities, supplier evaluations, contract negotiations, in line with FWWC27 management and procurement policies.
    • Maintain full budget oversight including forecasting, cost control, variations, and invoicing. Ensure contractual deliverables and timelines are aligned with pre‑production schedules and operational readiness requirements.
    • Conduct regular supplier update meetings and coordinate implementation processes.
  • Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison
    • Act as the senior liaison between the Entertainment Team and all relevant Functional Areas, including Venue Operations, Broadcast, Safety & Security, Marketing, and FIFA SPE.
    • Deliver concise briefings, alignment updates, and escalation management across all internal and external stakeholders.
    • Build and maintain relationships with Host Country national bodies, cultural organizations, and local partners contributing to ceremonies.
    • Ensure early‑phase cross‑functional integration to support seamless operational delivery.
  • Other Duties
    • Perform additional responsibilities as required by Senior Management aligned with project delivery.
    • Represent the Ceremonies function in cross‑functional planning forums and Senior Management briefings.
    • Support the Head of Entertainment in strategic planning, operational readiness, and tournament‑wide entertainment integration.

Your Profile

Education
  • Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience.
Experience
  • 7+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large-scale public events.
  • Prior experience in a FIFA tournament or comparable major international sports event is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, large-scale ceremonies including opening/closing ceremonies and awards presentations.
  • Proven track record in team management, creative development, supplier management, and cross‑functional coordination.
  • Significant experience managing RFP/procurement processes and overseeing multi‑supplier contracts and budgets.
  • Experience integrating cultural programming and working with national cultural bodies and creative agencies.
Skills & Competencies
  • ADMINISTRATIVE SKILLS: Ability to manage office and production documentation including RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately.
  • ADAPTABILITY: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high‑pressure environments.
  • FLEXIBILITY: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period.
  • COMMUNICATION SKILLS: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level.
  • ORGANIZATIONAL SKILLS: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines.
  • PROBLEM‑SOLVING SKILLS: Strategic and creative approach to problem‑solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure.
  • CROSS‑FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals.
  • INTERPERSONAL SKILLS: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross‑functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment.
  • CULTURAL SENSITIVITY: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant.
  • PASSION FOR ENTERTAINMENT: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire.
Certifications & Requirements
  • Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools.
  • Experience with Monday.com an advantage.
  • Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus.
  • The right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

  • Atender auditorias de SMS e Gestão Ambiental, e investigações de acidentes/incidentes, com foco na saúde dos trabalhadores, analisando impactos físicos e psicológicos relacionados e propor medidas preventivas e corretivas.

  • Desenvolver relatórios técnicos ou apresentações sobre SMS com foco em saúde ocupacional, incluindo análise de dados médicos, campanhas de saúde e pareceres sobre conformidade com o PCMSO e normas de saúde.
  • Utilizar as ferramentas de gestão de Saúde e SMS do cliente, tais como Audicomp, SIGEM, SISPEN, SALV2, AUDICOMP, SISIN, DDSMS, DATAHIDRO, SCR, SMSNet e SIGA, para garantir o monitoramento e atualização de informações relacionadas à saúde dos trabalhadores.

  • Participar de reuniões técnicas, elaborar minutas e pareceres técnicos sobre saúde ocupacional, incluindo indicadores de saúde, conformidade com o PCMSO e desempenho das contratadas.
  • Garantir a aplicação de ações do PCMSO, como a realização de exames médicos ocupacionais (admissionais, periódicos e demissionais) e a implementação de medidas preventivas.
  • Acompanhar casos de afastamentos por doenças ocupacionais, realizar intervenções preventivas e propor ações corretivas para preservar a saúde dos trabalhadores.
  • Implementar campanhas de promoção à saúde ocupacional.

  • Graduação em Enfermagem;
  • Pós-Graduação lato sensu (especialização) em Enfermagem do Trabalho.

title: Engineer - Pipe System Design
description:
Overview

Subsea Flexible Pipe System Design Engineer

Join Our Team and Shape the Future of Offshore Engineering! In NOV Subsea Production Systems (NOV SPS), part of the Fortune 500 company NOV, we power the industries that power the world. Our core business is engineering, manufacturing, and delivering high-quality flexible pipe systems for offshore oil and gas developments around the globe.

NOV SPS designs and manufactures flexible pipes and innovative subsea solutions for the offshore energy industry. With operations in Denmark (Brøndby and Kalundborg) and Brazil (Rio de Janeiro and Açu Port), we combine advanced engineering expertise with state-of-the-art manufacturing technology to deliver subsea equipment to major oil companies and installation contractors worldwide.

As demand for offshore flexible pipe systems continues to grow, we are looking for talented Pipe System Design Engineers to join our global engineering team in Brazil.

Your New Role

As part of the Pipe System Design Engineering department , you will contribute to the design and engineering of flexible pipe systems for offshore applications. Depending on your background and project needs, you may work with flexible riser system analysis or flexible pipe cross-section design , contributing to the technical development and integrity assessment of flexible pipe systems throughout project execution.

Working in a multidisciplinary environment, you will collaborate closely with other engineering disciplines, manufacturing, project management, and commercial teams to develop technically sound and cost-effective solutions for offshore field developments.

Your Responsibilities May Include

  • Designing and analyzing flexible pipe systems for offshore applications.
  • Performing structural and hydrodynamic analyses to evaluate the behavior of flexible pipes under operational, installation, and extreme environmental conditions.
  • Assessing key loading conditions including bending, tension, compression, fatigue, and environmental loads.
  • Supporting the design of flexible riser configurations (e.g., free-hanging, lazy wave) and associated components such as buoyancy modules and bend stiffeners.
  • Contributing to flexible pipe cross-section design, evaluating material compatibility, structural capacity, and potential failure modes.
  • Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, manufacturing, sales, and project management to ensure successful project execution.
  • Interfacing with clients, installation contractors, and independent verification agencies.
  • Preparing technical reports and documentation to support engineering decisions and project deliverables.
  • Ensuring compliance with industry standards such as API Spec 17J and API RP 17B.

You will be part of a global and diverse engineering organization , working on several major offshore projects simultaneously in a collaborative and international environment.

About You

At NOV, we are committed to supporting your professional development from day one. We are looking for engineers who are motivated to solve complex engineering challenges and contribute to the development of advanced offshore technologies.

To Succeed In This Role, You Typically Have

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering, Naval Architecture, Civil Engineering, Materials Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Experience in structural analysis, offshore engineering, or subsea systems (experience level may vary).
  • Familiarity with engineering tools such as Orcaflex, finite element analysis software, or similar simulation tools is an advantage.
  • Strong understanding of solid mechanics, hydrodynamics, fatigue analysis, and nonlinear structural behavior.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and international teams.
  • Good communication skills and ability to present technical information clearly.
  • Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken).

Why Join NOV SPS?

Flexible pipes are among the most complex engineered products in the offshore industry. Every system we deliver is custom designed to meet the specific operational requirements and environmental conditions of each offshore field — from Brazil to Australia, West Africa, and the North Sea.

Working at NOV SPS offers a unique opportunity to be involved in technically challenging projects that are critical to the global energy supply .

At NOV, You Will Find

  • A collaborative and international work environment
  • Opportunities to work on cutting-edge offshore engineering solutions
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Opportunities for professional growth within a global organization
  • Exposure to both engineering design and manufacturing environments

Occasional travel may be required to support project activities or visit NOV sites and customers. You will also have opportunities to visit our Açu manufacturing facility , where you can see flexible pipe systems being produced and prepared for offshore installation.

Interested? If you are passionate about offshore engineering and eager to contribute to innovative subsea solutions, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now and become part of a company dedicated to innovation, engineering excellence, and safety.

title: Logistics Coordinator
description:
Job Summary

This role acts as the vital link between procurement and operations, ensuring that all materials are expedited, cleared through customs, and delivered to the vessel on schedule and within budget.

Key Responsibilities

Expediting & Vendor Management

  • Order Tracking: Actively monitor the status of all open purchase orders (Local and Overseas) to ensure vendor compliance with delivery dates.
  • Proactive Problem Solving: Identify potential delays in the manufacturing or shipping process and elevate to the Procurement and Technical team as needed.

International Freight & Customs Coordination

  • Freight Forwarder Management: Coordinate with global freight forwarders to book shipments via air or sea ensuring the most cost-effective and timely routes.
  • Brazil Customs Compliance: Work closely with Brazil customs brokers to ensure all documentation (Invoices, Packing Lists) is accurate to prevent costly delays at the port.
  • Consolidation: Manage the consolidation of shipments at the Brazil warehouse to optimize container space and reduce freight spend.

Operational Support & Reporting

  • SSAV Delivery: Ensure the "last mile" delivery to the vessels is coordinated with Petrobras and vessel captains.
  • Data Integrity: Maintain accurate records in the procurement system (e.g., ABS NS) regarding shipment status and delivery completion.
  • Cross-Functional Backup: Assist the wider Supply Chain team during peak periods and provide input for process improvements in the Brazil logistics flow.

Required Education & Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum 1 year experience in logistics, freight forwarding, or supply chain, preferably within the Shipping or Offshore (O&G) industry.
  • Knowledge: Good understanding of Incoterms 2020, shipping documentation, and international freight processes. Experience with Brazil customs regulations is highly advantageous.
  • Education: Certificate in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or a related field.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong communication skills to manage diverse stakeholders (Forwarders, Brokers, Suppliers).
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple shipments.
  • Proficiency in Excel and procurement/logistics software.

title: Manager, Stadium Entertainment
description:
Manager, Stadium Entertainment

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Stadium Entertainment Manager will be responsible for the planning, coordination and delivery of all in‑stadium entertainment activations across all assigned venues of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

Reporting to the Head of Entertainment and supporting the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager, this role ensures that all entertainment elements — including pre‑match programming, music, audio‑visual content, half‑time activations, and fan engagement moments — are delivered to the highest standard. The role supports and coordinates the implementation of the Stadium Entertainment operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, in accordance with the Stadium Entertainment Concept developed by FIFA.

Working closely with venue teams, technical suppliers, and the broader Entertainment department, the Stadium Entertainment Manager will act as the primary entertainment point of contact for their assigned venue(s), managing operational workflows, coordinating suppliers, and overseeing delivery timelines from a central coordination function. This role works in close collaboration with the on‑site venue entertainment teams, providing the planning structure, content, and operational direction required for seamless execution on match days.

The Stadium Entertainment Manager is an office‑based coordination role suited to an experienced live events professional with strong project management skills, who can drive high‑quality entertainment delivery across multiple venues through effective planning, clear communication, and proactive stakeholder management.

Key Responsibilities

Stadium Entertainment Delivery

  • Manage the day‑to‑day planning and delivery of all entertainment activations at assigned venue(s).
  • Execute the FIFA‑approved Entertainment Concept at venue level, maintaining quality and consistency throughout the tournament.
  • Coordinate all entertainment elements on match days, including pre‑match shows, half‑time activations, music programming and AV content.
  • Act as the primary on‑site entertainment point of contact for venue management, technical crews, and Functional Area partners.

Team Support

  • Support the Stadium Entertainment Team by contributing to day‑to‑day coordination, operational readiness, and delivery standards across all entertainment activities.
  • Assist with the onboarding and support of Stadium Entertainment personnel—including full‑time staff, freelancers, and event‑time workforce—helping ensure consistent standards and operational preparedness.
  • Contribute to internal talent development through daily guidance, structured feedback, and knowledge sharing within the entertainment workstream.
  • Support effective collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units involved in stadium entertainment delivery.
  • Contribute to coordination between venue‑based entertainment teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution across all stadiums.
  • Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Ceremonies Team to ensure unified delivery across entertainment and ceremonial workstreams.

Technical & Production Coordination

  • Liaise with technical suppliers including AV, LED, sound, and lighting providers to ensure correct installation and operation of all entertainment infrastructure.
  • Support pre‑event technical surveys, production walkthroughs, and infrastructure assessments at assigned venues.
  • Coordinate rehearsals and technical run‑throughs, ensuring all entertainment elements are tested and validated before match day.
  • Manage show rundowns, cue sheets, and entertainment schedules for each match at assigned venue(s).

Venue Readiness & Execution

  • Support the preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), stadium production schedules, and PMC rundowns for Stadium Entertainment.
  • Assist in preproduction processes, including coordinating technical surveys, gathering stadium LED screen specs, AV infrastructure reviews, and supplier installation planning.
  • Contribute to readiness activities and provide on‑site support during live operations to ensure delivery standards are met.
  • Support problem solving during matchday entertainment, escalating issues to the Senior Manager as needed.
  • Coordinate rehearsal planning, scheduling, documentation, and stakeholder communication in alignment with Senior Manager guidance.
  • Support the validation of entertainment elements during pre‑event testing and rehearsal phases.
  • Assist with venue‑level pre‑production tasks, including gathering technical information, supporting infrastructure assessments, and coordinating installation planning.

Content Production & Management

  • Coordinate the receipt, testing, and deployment of all entertainment content at venue level, including music, video, graphics, and scripts.
  • Ensure that all content is approved, correctly formatted, and delivered on time in line with operational deadlines.
  • Maintain accurate records of content usage and ensure IP/copyright compliance at venue level.

Planning Scheduling & Documentation

  • Prepare match‑day reports, schedules, show notes and post‑event summaries for the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date operational documentation including rundowns, contact lists, and venue entertainment plans.
  • Participate in regular team meetings, briefings, and review sessions.
  • Flag operational risks and elevate issues to the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager in a timely manner.

Supplier & Budget Management

  • Support procurement processes as directed by the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager, including supplier briefing and evaluation.
  • Manage day‑to‑day relationships with entertainment suppliers and contractors at assigned venue(s).
  • Assist with budget management tasks, including forecasting inputs, cost‑tracking, variation documentation, and invoice processing, ensuring accuracy and timely follow‑up.
  • Help monitor contractual deliverables and timelines, ensuring they remain aligned with pre‑production schedules and operational readiness requirements, and escalating risks to the Senior Manager as needed.

Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison

  • Coordinate with Venue Operations, Broadcast, Protocol, Safety, and other Functional Areas and stakeholders to integrate entertainment seamlessly into match‑day operations.
  • Support early‑phase cross‑functional integration to support seamless operational delivery.

Other Duties

  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by line management aligned with project delivery.
  • Support the Head of Entertainment and Senior Stadium Entertainment Manager in planning, operational readiness, and tournament‑wide entertainment integration.
  • Support cross‑venue entertainment activities and cover other venues as required during the tournament.

Your Profile

Education

  • Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience.

Experience

  • 5+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large‑scale public events.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering in‑venue or stadium entertainment programmes, including AV, music and audience engagement activations.
  • Experience working within large‑scale multi‑venue events or major international sporting events is highly desirable.
  • Track record of coordinating multiple suppliers and technical teams in high‑pressure, time‑critical environments.
  • Experience working with broadcast operations and an understanding of live TV production constraints is an advantage.

Skills & Competencies

  • Administrative skills: Ability to manage office and production documentation including RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately.
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high‑pressure environments.
  • Flexibility: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period.
  • Communication skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level.
  • Organizational skills: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines.
  • Problem‑solving skills: Strategic and creative approach to problem‑solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure.
  • Cross‑functional collaboration: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals.
  • Interpersonal skills: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross‑functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment.
  • Cultural sensitivity: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant.
  • Passion for entertainment: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools.
  • Experience with Monday.com an advantage.
  • Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus.
  • The right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Associate, Finance - Payroll
description:
The FSG Finance Associate supports the payroll department’s day-to-day functions, including end-to-end payroll processing, calculating fixed and variable payments, overtime, and off-cycle payments, and ensuring compliance with complex local labor laws (CLT) and tax regulations.

What You Will Do

  • Payroll data collection and validation, such as overtime, night-shift, new hires, terminations, and vacations.
  • Maintain and update employee records in the payroll system, including hiring documentation, salary changes, personal information, and bank details.
  • Reconcile payroll data with HR records and finance systems before bank transfers.
  • Monitor leave, sick pay, maternity/paternity leave, and vacation accruals, ensuring accurate deductions and salary adjustments.
  • Ensure accurate calculation of mandatory deductions, including social/security contributions, withholding income tax, and Severance Indemnity Fund (8% employer contribution).
  • Act as the first point of contact for employee inquiries regarding pay, deductions, and tax documentation.
  • Assist with terminations, calculating severance payments, and handling new hire documentation.
  • Perform gross-to-net validations and partner with Finance to reconcile payroll funding and journal entries.
  • Assist with internal and external audits, providing payroll documentation.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities for process improvement and efficiency in your area of responsibility while minimizing risk and cost.

What You Will Need

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
  • Advanced degree.
  • One (1) or more years of experience.
  • Professional certification preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Knowledge of data privacy and security principles.
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian Labor Law (CLT) and current tax regulations.
  • Proficiency with localized Brazilian payroll/HR systems (Cloudpay, Apdata) and MS Excel.
  • Capacity to analyze, interpret, and report payroll data.
  • Accurately and efficiently input payroll data into spreadsheets or payroll system; complete high-quality data reconciliations.
  • Technically proficient with payroll systems and strong knowledge of data analysis techniques and data visualization tools and software.
  • Experience with eSocial implementation.
  • Communicate basic insights from payroll data analysis.
  • Accountability / reliability / quality / service delivery.
  • Ability to demonstrate independent, objective, open-minded thinking with strong attention to detail and sound judgment.
  • Responsibility for actions, decisions, and results while holding self and team members accountable.
  • Meet expected levels of acceptable work quality (accuracy, completeness, & timeliness).
  • Communication: listens, clarifies, responds well, speaks clearly and persuasively, writes clearly and informatively.
  • Employee development: completes assigned and mandatory training; demonstrates understanding of tasks.
  • Leadership: all levels of the organization demonstrate leadership through actions and behaviors; act as a role model; embrace change; coach and develop key skills.
  • People / teamwork: actively participate in a team; collaborate effectively; respect individuals and recognize viewpoints; understand teamwork importance.
  • Working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental Management Systems.

Reporting Relationships

Reports directly to the Payroll Supervisor.

description:

Yinson is an equal opportunity employer.

The Project Coordinator is responsible for leading and supervising the performance and execution of the project and activities. Acts as a strategic link between technical support, operations, commissioning, construction, HSEQ, procurement and logistics teams, ensuring that all deliverables are carried out safely, within the schedule and budget, in compliance with regulatory and contractual requirements and the company's integrity standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain execution plans and the proper allocation of personnel and equipment resources.
  • Monitor activity costs, ensuring all remain within the allocated budget, in conjunction with the company's controllers.
  • Supervise all execution, personnel and equipment mobilization and/or demobilization plans and activities.

  • Act as the focal point of contact for all activities, managing communications between departments, contractors and other stakeholders.
  • Coordinate and collaborate with procurement and logistics teams on the action plan to ensure the timely availability of resources for activities.
  • Coordinate, supervise the performance of and provide guidance to third parties, engineering, operations, commissioning and construction teams, as well as adherence to safety standards.
  • Maintain contact with the Technical Support Manager for alignment of strategies and initiatives.
  • Supervise riser pull-in activities with subcontractors and the client.
  • Monitor and record any deviation from quality standards as per the contract and scope of work.
  • Conduct regular quality inspections of work performed, especially upon completion of each activity.
  • Collect, verify and control all documentation, ensuring the quality of information as well as project requirements.
  • Ensure that all relevant policies, procedures, task plans and checklists are available and communicated.
  • Ensure the delivery of the unit project in compliance with the integrity conditions and standards established by the company.
  • Track time consumed and progress in relation to contracted personnel, rented equipment and consumable consumption.
  • Ensure that the Permit to Work (PTW) system is complied with across all project activities.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Naval, Production, Petroleum or related fields) — BSc/MSc.
  • Active CREA (Regional Council of Engineering and Agronomy).
  • Postgraduate degree or MBA in Project Management (PMP, PMI or equivalent).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills at all levels of the organization.
  • Fluency in English (verbal and written) — essential for interaction with international teams.
  • Solid technical knowledge of FPSO systems and equipment.
  • Proficiency in project planning and control tools (MS Project, Primavera or similar).
  • Knowledge of Integrated Management Systems (IMS) and technical documentation platforms.
  • Familiarity with offshore industry regulations and technical standards.
  • Knowledge of Permit to Work (PTW) system management.

Professional Experience

  • Solid experience in project coordination on FPSOs or large-scale projects in the international oil and gas industry.
  • Experience in activity management on FPSOs.
  • Experience in cost control in the offshore oil and gas sector.
  • Experience in technical maintenance roles and maintenance philosophy on offshore units.
  • Experience in supervising contractors and subcontractors in an offshore environment.
  • Previous experience in FPSO engineering projects (construction, commissioning, operation).
  • Commercial knowledge and experience in contract management.
  • Experience with document management systems and quality control.

Competencies

  • Results-oriented leadership, capable of motivating multidisciplinary teams in a high-pressure environment.
  • Ability to work as part of a team and build solid relationships with clients, contractors and partners.
  • Generalist, dynamic profile capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify solutions in an agile manner.
  • High degree of responsibility, attention to detail and focus on delivering results.
  • Self-management, proactivity and initiative to anticipate risks and propose improvements.
  • Commercial focus: ability to identify and react to changes in contractual scope, protecting the company's interests.

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades

  • Recepcionar todos os clientes, profissionais e usuários
  • Anunciar os visitantes aos setores solicitados
  • Fiscalizar a entrada e saída de pessoas, veículos, prestadores de serviços
  • Monitorar as imagens de locais específicos da Instituição (via circuito interno de imagens)
  • Efetuar atendimento telefônico com direcionamento aos processos conforme necessidade
  • Fazer a comunicação imediata de ocorrência de qualquer anormalidade com relação a pessoas, ou veículos nas proximidades da portaria
  • Zelar para o desenvolvimento das atividades com atenção e objetividade
  • Desempenhar as atribuições pertinentes ao cargo sempre com atenção e respeito a todos os profissionais e visitantes
  • Efetuar diariamente controle de acionamento e desligamento da iluminação das áreas comuns da Instituição, observando os horários e/ou necessidades
  • Auxiliar, quando solicitado e autorizado, os demais colegas da portaria em suas bases administrativas
  • Controlar para que pessoas que não pertençam ao processo ou que não sejam vinculadas a qualquer atividade dos setores da SPDM/PAIS, ingressem nas dependências sem autorização dos Gestores
  • Realizar as atividades das áreas/setores, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição

Qualificações

  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função

Local de trabalho: A.P. 3.3 (Madureira e bairros adjacentes)

Benefícios e Parcerias:

  • Vale Refeição ou Vale Alimentação
  • Assistência Médica por adesão
  • Assistência Odontológica por adesão
  • Disponibilizamos parcerias com Wellhub (Gympass), SESC, Zenklub, faculdades, universidades e farmácias

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

title: Assistant Director of Career & Professional Development - Judicial Clerkships & Fellowships
description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Assistant Director of Judicial Clerkships & Fellowships will serve as a key member of the law school’s Career Services Office, dedicated to supporting students and alumni seeking to secure judicial clerkships. The Assistant Director will provide comprehensive career counseling, develop strategic partnerships with the judiciary, and oversee programs and initiatives that enhance students\'s and graduates\' competitiveness for clerkship positions. Additionally, this role will play an integral part in identifying and assisting with specialty fellowship development pipelines.

Supervisory Accountability

Supervises student workers, temporary personnel, administrative staff, and volunteers as needed. Reports to the Dean of Career & Professional Development, Lauren Jackson.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, staff, and students in the School of Law and other University departments. External contacts include judges, organizations focused on judicial placement, serve as liaison to the Judicial Clerkship Committee, and other important contacts as deemed necessary.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Judicial Clerkship Advising: Provide individualized career counseling to students and alumni interested in judicial clerkships, including state, federal, and international positions.
  • Guide students through the application process, including resume and cover letter review, interview preparation, and navigating the OSCAR system (Online System for Clerkship Application and Review).
  • Offer specialized workshops, panels, and informational sessions on the benefits of judicial clerkships and strategies for securing them.
  • Partnership Development: Cultivate relationships with judges, court administrators, and public interest employers to create opportunities for clerkships and public sector employment.
  • Collaborate with alumni who have clerkship experience to build mentoring and networking opportunities for current students.
  • Organize and lead outreach initiatives to enhance the school’s reputation within the judiciary and public interest communities.
  • Assist with developing relationships with prominent fellowship organizations.
  • Program Management: Develop and manage programs that increase students\' and graduates\' exposure to clerkships, such as clerkship boot camps, alumni panels, and judicial internships.
  • Track and analyze data on clerkship placement and public interest employment to assess the effectiveness of programs and adapt strategies accordingly.
  • Administer funding opportunities, including stipends and fellowships, to support students pursuing unpaid clerkships.
  • Manage clerkship resources for the office such as the Vermont Clerkship Guides, NBLSA Judicial Directory, CORA, and other relevant sites.

    • Perform diagnostics on pumps, centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, gearboxes, and Dry Gas Seal systems; recommend corrective actions.
    • Identify and manage “bad actors,” drive elimination plans, and prioritize investments to sustain reliability improvements.
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
    • Lead RCA for failures and recurring issues using structured methodologies (5 Whys, Ishikawa, TapRooT, etc.); issue actionable reports and verify effectiveness of actions.
    • Conduct component failure analyses (seals, bearings, rotors, gears, shafts) and propose design, operational, or maintenance improvements.
  • Troubleshooting & Technical Support
    • Provide day‑to‑day technical support to Operations and Maintenance to resolve machinery issues, unplanned shutdowns, and control/operating parameter optimizations.
    • Offer guidance for commissioning/start‑up, operations, overhauls, and controls/monitoring upgrades for rotating equipment.
  • Asset Lifecycle & Projects (Design Review & Installations)
    • Support capital projects by reviewing specifications for maintainability and reliability and ensuring correct installation/alignment per API/AGMA/ISO.
    • Support preparation of Technical Risk Assessments (TRA) and contribute to continuous improvement of processes and systems.

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering. MBA/Postgraduate in Reliability, Maintenance, or Asset Management is a plus.
  • Experience in rotating equipment operations, maintenance, or reliability in Oil & Gas (offshore/onshore), focusing on centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, pumps, and turbomachinery.
  • Strong knowledge of rotating equipment reliability, RCM, CBM, and PDM services.
  • Hands‑on experience in condition monitoring (vibration, oil analysis, thermography) and failure diagnostics.
  • Demonstrated troubleshooting and field condition monitoring experience.
  • Solid knowledge of API standards (e.g., 610/617/618/670/682/686), machinery design, lubrication, mechanical seals (incl. Dry Gas Seals), rotor dynamics, balancing, alignment, and modal analysis.
  • Working knowledge of international codes and standards (ASME, ANSI, ISO 10816/20816);
  • Deep understanding of rotating equipment: pumps, compressors, Dry Gas Seal systems, and gearboxes.
  • Vibration analysis certification (e.g., ISO CAT II/III) desired; oil analysis/thermography certifications are advantageous.

Systems & Software

  • Proficiency with CMMS (SAP preferred) and machinery/condition monitoring software.
  • OSIsoft PI System and System 1 knowledge is differential. Advanced Microsoft Office: Power BI is a plus.
  • Advanced English.
  • Active CREA (as applicable for Brazil).

  • Actively drive and improve recruitment
  • Foster psychological safety and facilitate conflict resolution and performance issues

title: Fan Services Manager
description:
Fan Services Manager

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027. That will be hosted in South America in Brazil for the first time ever. This is an opportunity to be part of the workforce that is creating an unique and unforgettable experience.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Head of Venue Operations, the Fan Services Manager is responsible for delivering a world-class fan experience at the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027. This role leads the planning, coordination, and delivery of fan services across all venues, ensuring that spectators enjoy a safe, welcoming, and seamless experience from arrival to departure.

The Fan Services Manager acts as the primary point of contact for all key fan service deliverables within stadium operations, ensuring consistency and compliance with agreed service standards across the tournament.

This role requires effective management of spectator services, close coordination with FIFA Functional Areas, and strong engagement with internal and external stakeholders. Key focus areas include clear communication, problem‑solving, innovation, issue escalation, transparency, and the use of reporting tools to ensure operational excellence.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of Fan Services operations across all venues.
  • Ensure high-quality fan experiences aligned with FIFA service standards and spectator expectations.
  • Work closely with stadium Spectator Service, Guest Experience, Operations, Security, and other teams to integrate tournament operations with existing services, including the development and execution of efficient Spectator Service and Crowd Management plans.
  • Coordinate with FIFA Functional Areas, stadiums, and external stakeholders on Last Mile operations to ensure safe, efficient access to and from venues.
  • Develop and manage the Fan Services project plan, ensuring alignment with the overall FWWC2027 programme.
  • Oversee fan service spaces, assets, Furniture, Fixtures & Equipment (FF&E), and related logistics across venues.
  • Manage staff and volunteer requirements for Fan Services central and in each stadium.
  • Support procurement processes by defining operational and technical requirements for fan services at each stadium.
  • Contribute to budget planning, track delivery, and support post‑event reporting and debriefing.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks related to fan services across all venues.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • University degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education).
  • Bilingual - Brazilian Portuguese and English.
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years delivering Fan Services at international sporting events.
  • Proven experience managing fan services for complex, multi‑venue events involving multiple stakeholders and authorities.
  • Strong knowledge of crowd management particularly within sporting events.
  • Solid understanding of event planning and project management methodologies.
  • Demonstrated excellence in customer service delivery.
  • Strong presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and lead cross‑functional teams without formal reporting lines.
  • Experience in budgeting, financial oversight, and resource management for large‑scale events.
  • Strong crisis‑management capability with the ability to remain calm and decisive under pressure.
  • Familiarity with host stadium operations is considered an asset.
  • Flexibility and adaptability in dynamic and evolving environments.
  • Strong IT proficiency, including MS Office and Visio.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong team player with ability to meet tight deadlines.
  • Solution‑oriented mindset with resilience and positivity under pressure.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage high workloads during peak periods.
  • Sound judgment and critical problem‑solving skills.
  • Effective leadership, motivational, and negotiation skills.
  • High energy, adaptability, and entrepreneurial spirit.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Cultural awareness and sensitivity, with experience in international contexts.

Requirement

  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Senior Manager, Ceremonies
description:
Senior Manager, Ceremonies

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC27”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

THE POSITION

The Ceremonies Senior Manager leads the end‑to‑end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre‑Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half‑Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments.

Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, this role is responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of each ceremony—from planning and preparation through to live execution—ensuring full alignment with FIFA’s vision and brand standards. The role also manages the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA.

Working closely with the Entertainment team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Senior Manager acts as the senior operational lead for all ceremony delivery, ensuring creative and operational approvals are met and delivering iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Ceremonies Project Leadership

  • Lead the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA.
  • Manage the end-to-end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament.
  • Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through preproduction, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover.
  • Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams.
  • Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables.
  • Provide senior decision-making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation.
  • Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC.
  • Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into matchday and event day operations.
  • Act as the senior escalation authority for all ceremony related operational matters.
  • Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy.

Team Leadership

  • Manage and mentor the Ceremonies Team, providing clear direction, performance oversight, and accountability structures.
  • Mentor and support all Ceremonies personnel, including fulltime staff, freelancers, and event time workforce, ensuring consistent standards, development pathways, and operational readiness.
  • Support internal talent development through coaching, guidance, and structured feedback.
  • Build team structures and optimize collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units.
  • Foster strong coordination between venue based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution.
  • Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonial workstreams.

Major Ceremonies Oversight

  • Manage planning and delivery management for all major ceremonial events, including: Opening Ceremony, Closing Ceremony, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half-Time Show (if applicable), Pre-Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament
  • Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management

  • Collaborate with the Entertainment team to develop and refine the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony.
  • Integrate host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful way.
  • Oversee creative brief development, content commissioning, and pre-production workflows with internal teams and external agencies.
  • Ensure all creative content — including music, graphics, videos, scripts, translations, choreography and performances — is approved and locked in line with operational timelines.
  • Manage stakeholder approval pathways to ensure content is delivered and archived in accordance with operational requirements.
  • Manage IP and copyright compliance for all ceremony content.

Planning Scheduling & Documentation

  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams.
  • Ensure all operational and creative decisions are fully documented and version controlled.
  • Manage multiple suppliers, conduct regular update meetings, coordinate implementation processes, and supervise payments and reporting.
  • Prepare written and oral presentations, high-level briefings, and reports for senior leadership and FIFA counterparts.
  • Organize and participate in Review, Project Team, and Status Update meetings.
  • Lead the creation, management, and archiving of project plans, workflows, venue documentation, and readiness tools across all ceremony workstreams.
  • Manage the development of operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and rehearsal programmes for all ceremonies.
  • Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event.
  • Act as the key operational decision-maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies.
  • Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals and stakeholder coordination for all ceremonies.
  • Direct venue-level pre-production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, and infrastructure planning.

Supplier & Budget Management

  • Lead early stage budget modelling, scenario planning, and resourcing strategies to support creative and operational planning.
  • Develop and manage Scopes of Work, Procurement activities, supplier evaluations, contract negotiations, in line with FWWC27 management and procurement policies. Manage procurement activities for stadium entertainment suppliers, including RFP development, evaluation, and contract negotiation.
  • Maintain full budget oversight including forecasting, cost control, variations, and invoicing. Manage budget oversight for the stadium entertainment workstream, including forecasting, cost control and invoicing.
  • Ensure contractual deliverables and timelines are aligned with preproduction schedules and operational readiness requirements.
  • Conduct regular supplier update meetings and coordinate implementation processes.
  • Supervise payments, deliverables and performance reports from entertainment suppliers.

Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison

  • Act as the senior liaison between the Ceremonies Team and all relevant Functional Areas, including Venue Operations, Broadcast, Safety & Security, Marketing, and FIFA SPE.
  • Deliver concise briefings, alignment updates, and escalation management across all internal and external stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain relationships with Host Country national bodies, cultural organizations, and local partners contributing to ceremonies.
  • Ensure early phase cross functional integration to support seamless operational delivery.

Venue Readiness & Execution

  • Lead preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), ceremony production schedules, and PMC rundowns.
  • Direct venue level preproduction processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, performer logistics, and infrastructure planning.
  • Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event.
  • Act as the key operational decision maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies.
  • Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals and stakeholder coordination.
  • Ensure all creative and technical elements are validated during pre event testing and rehearsal phases.

Other Duties

  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by senior managership aligned with project delivery.
  • Represent the Ceremonies function in cross-functional planning forums and senior managership briefings.
  • Support the Head of Entertainment in strategic planning, operational readiness, and tournament wide entertainment integration.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience.

Experience

  • 7+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large-scale public events.
  • Prior experience in a FIFA tournament or comparable major international sports event is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, large-scale ceremonies including opening/closing ceremonies and awards presentations.
  • Proven track record in team managership, creative development, supplier management, and cross-functional coordination.
  • Significant experience managing RFP/procurement processes and overseeing multi-supplier contracts and budgets.
  • Experience integrating cultural programming and working with national cultural bodies and creative agencies.

Skills & Competencies

  • ADMINISTRATIVE SKILLS: Ability to manage office and production documentation including, RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately.
  • ADAPTABILITY: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high-pressure environments.
  • FLEXIBILITY: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period.
  • COMMUNICATION SKILLS: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level.
  • ORGANIZATIONAL SKILLS: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines.
  • PROBLEM‑SOLVING SKILLS: Strategic and creative approach to problem‑solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure.
  • CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLABORATION: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals.
  • INTERPERSONAL SKILLS: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross‑functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment
  • CULTURAL SENSITIVITY: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant.
  • PASSION FOR ENTERTAINMENT: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools.
  • Experience of Monday.com an advantage.
  • Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus
  • The right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.
